title: Simultaneous amplicon analysis of multiple soil samples using MinION sequencing
author: Kurokochi, Yoshitake, et al.
materials: DNA was extracted from a total of 36 soil samples and 2 fallen leaves of E. polyandra using ISOIL (Nippon Gene Co., Ltd., Tokyo, Japan). The average amount of the soil samples used for DNA extraction was 0.30 g (s.d., 0.01 g), and that ofE. polyandra samples was 0.04 g and 0.06 g. The concentration of each extracted DNA sample was measured using a Qubit2.0 Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

In total, of 80 amplicons were obtained, and purified using Agencourt AMPure XP (Beckman Coulter, CA, USA). The concentration of the amplicons after purification was measured using a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific), and a mixture of all samples was prepared using the same amount of DNA, and this was used as a library. The library was processed using the Ligation Sequencing Kit (SQR-LSK109, Oxford Nanopore Technologies) and was subjected to amplicon sequencing using MinION (Oxford Nanopore Technologies).

steps.title: Prepare raw and sterilized soil
steps.instruction: Air‑dry brown forest soil for 1 year, mix evenly and sieve through a 2 mm mesh to obtain “raw soil”. Autoclave an aliquot of the raw soil at 121 °C for 3 h, then cool at room temperature for 24 h to obtain “sterilized soil”.

steps.title: Set up soil containers
steps.instruction: Label twelve plastic containers with lids. Fill six containers (I–VI) with 300 g raw soil each and the other six containers (1–6) with 300 g sterilized soil each.

steps.title: Initial sampling and add organisms
steps.instruction: At experiment start, collect 2 g of soil from each of containers I, II, III, 1, 2, 3 (once) and store in Unipack tubes. From containers IV, V, VI, 4, 5, 6 collect 2 g of soil twice from each container and store in Unipack. Add several fallen leaves of Euptelea polyandra and several pill bugs to every container. Store containers in a cool, dark place at room temperature. Store a portion of the fallen leaves at –80 °C.

steps.title: Weekly humidification of containers
steps.instruction: Once per week, add 50 cc (≈50 mL) distilled water to each container to maintain humidity.

steps.title: Collect final soil samples
steps.instruction: Two weeks after the start, collect soil from all containers in the same manner as the initial sampling (total 18 samples) and store the tubes at –80 °C.

steps.title: Extract DNA from samples
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the 36 soil samples and 2 leaf samples using the ISOIL kit (Nippon Gene Co., Ltd., Tokyo, Japan). Use an average of 0.30 g (±0.01 g) soil per extraction; leaf samples use 0.04 g and 0.06 g respectively. Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

steps.title: Purify amplicons and pool library
steps.instruction: Purify the 80 amplicons with Agencourt AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter, CA, USA). Measure amplicon concentration with the Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer. Pool equal amounts of each amplicon to create a combined library.

steps.title: Prepare MinION sequencing library
steps.instruction: Process the pooled amplicon library using the Ligation Sequencing Kit (SQR‑LSK109, Oxford Nanopore Technologies) and load onto a MinION device (Oxford Nanopore Technologies) for sequencing.

steps.title: Process sequencing reads bioinformatically
steps.instruction: Create a FASTA file of the barcoded primers and build a BLAST database with makeblastdb. Filter reads: keep 1200–1700 bp (16S) and 600–900 bp (ITS) sequences; run blastn with –word_size 4; retain hits with ≥90 % primer alignment. Extract reads that have barcoded primers on both ends and trim primer sequences. Perform these steps with the “nanopore~split-barcode” pipeline in Portable Pipeline v0.9c (https://github.com/c2997108/OpenPortablePipeline).

steps.title: Perform 16S taxonomic assignment
steps.instruction: Run the “metagenomics~silva_SSU+LSU” pipeline in Portable Pipeline v0.9c with option –t 0.995. Blast reads against the merged SILVA v.132 SSU+LSU database; keep reads with bitscore ≥100 and aggregate hits with bitscore ≥99.5 % of the top hit. Assign taxonomy using the lowest common ancestor method.

steps.title: Perform ITS taxonomic assignment
steps.instruction: Run the “metagenome~use-genbank-fasta-as-reference” pipeline in Portable Pipeline v0.9c using a database of 503 331 ITS sequences downloaded from NCBI GenBank (August 2019). Apply the same bitscore thresholds (≥100 and ≥99.5 %) as for 16S.

steps.title: Calculate OTUs and diversity metrics
steps.instruction: Treat the estimated taxa as operational taxonomic units (OTU_16S and OTU_ITS). Using R, calculate the number of OTUs, Shannon diversity index, and reciprocal dominance (R) for each sample. Perform non‑metric multidimensional scaling (NMDS) with the vegan package and cluster OTUs with >1 read using the pvclust package.
